description: This Java configuration class sets up a Spring Batch job for accrual activity posting within the loan account module. It defines beans for the job and its step, wiring together the tasklet with transaction management.

classes.name: AccrualActivityPostingConfig
classes.description: Configuration class defining the batch job for accrual activity posting, utilizing Spring Batch components.

methods.name: accrualActivityPostingStep
methods.description: Defines a batch step for accrual activity posting using a tasklet, transaction manager, and a step builder.

methods.name: accrualActivityPostingJob
methods.description: Creates the batch job that executes the accrual activity posting step with a run ID incrementer.
